key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence helped OpenPerov reason about perovskite solar cells and select a contact material that outperformed an expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could guide interface-material selection and experimental design for more efficient, thermally stable perovskite solar cells.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,532 articles.
Adapt models using linked strategies, controls, observations and mechanistic interpretations.
Refine selected responses with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a self-assembled monolayer choice.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash led 13 closed-book systems; the selected K-analogue contact enabled 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% retention after 1,000 h of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal ageing test does not establish durability under illumination or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
